# Businesses Beyond Borders

> Businesses Beyond Borders (BBB) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization headquartered in Port Orange, Florida. Founded in 2022 by Jacken Holland, BBB empowers entrepreneurs in Central Asia (Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan) through free financial literacy training, business creation courses, startup capital, and leadership development. The organization operates a four-stage model: Activate (financial literacy), Equip (business creation), Empower (startup capital), and Multiply (community leadership).

BBB's mission is that the hopeless find hope and that hope multiplies. Programs are free, evidence-based, and designed for local communities. The financial literacy course covers zero-based budgeting, debt management, savings strategies, and financial planning. The business creation course teaches market research, business planning, and launch preparation. Graduates who complete the full journey may receive startup capital of $2,000-$5,000 to launch real businesses.

Contact: donations@businessesbeyondborders.com | (386) 517-1527
Website: https://businessesbeyondborders.com
Location: Port Orange, Florida (Volusia County)

## About

- [About Us](https://businessesbeyondborders.com/about): Founder story, team bios, mission, values, and why BBB focuses on Central Asia
- [Programs & Impact](https://businessesbeyondborders.com/programs-and-impact): Overview of all four program stages and measurable impact

## Programs

- [Financial Literacy Program](https://businessesbeyondborders.com/programs/financial-literacy): Free 6-week or 10-week financial literacy course covering budgeting, saving, debt management, and financial planning
- [Business Creation Program](https://businessesbeyondborders.com/programs/business-creation): 12-week business creation training with mentorship, market research, and business plan development
- [Leadership Development](https://businessesbeyondborders.com/programs/leadership-development): Graduate program training entrepreneurs to become facilitators, mentors, and community leaders
- [Community Collaboration](https://businessesbeyondborders.com/programs/community-collaboration): Partnerships and community-driven development initiatives across Central Asia

## Courses

- [Financial Literacy Course](https://businessesbeyondborders.com/course/financial-literacy): Self-paced financial literacy curriculum with 6 weeks of daily content covering income mapping, zero-based budgeting, debt strategies, emergency funds, and goal setting
- [Business Creation Course](https://businessesbeyondborders.com/course/business-creation): Self-paced 12-week business creation curriculum covering ideation, market research, business models, financial projections, and launch planning
- [Leadership Development Course](https://businessesbeyondborders.com/course/leadership-development): Self-paced leadership development curriculum for graduates who want to become facilitators and community leaders
